name: EMWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Known from two documents, both of them another federation's. John Girder was billed as its holder when the EMWA put the belt against the FWF's own World Championship at Dreamcard V in April 1992 — "Who is the REAL World Champion in fantasy wrestling?", the card asked — and he lost by disqualification when his opponent threw him a set of brass knuckles behind the referee's back and then acted as though he had been hit with them. By that October the FWF was calling him "at least former" champion. No ledger of the EMWA's own survives, and no other holder is named anywhere this project holds.
notes: The Dreamcard V card (promotions/dreamcard/archive/dreamcard-v-the-rising-sun-final-lineup-1992-04-16.html) and the FWF's own singles ledger (promotions/fwf-1992/archive/fwf-singles-record-1993-01-08.html) and its own match report of 3 October 1992 (promotions/fwf-1992/archive/fwf-damien-vs-hurricane-1992-10-03.html).

name: EMWA Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Known only from a single holder: the community's own 1996 Hall of Fame record credits Brewster Cogburn with winning this title during the EMWA's founding-era (1990-94) run, alongside titles he later held in other federations. No ledger of challengers, defenses or an end to the reign survives in anything this project holds.
notes: Sourced entirely from third-party corroboration — the rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy community Hall of Fame's own 1996 nomination and inductee documents (served under promotions/rspwf/archive/) — rather than from any EMWA-original card; no EMWA-own title ledger from the 1990-94 era survives in this project's holdings.
